system.description:
Usable only by Magic-Users

This slender rod of petrified wind acts as a staff +2, striking for 1d6+2 points of damage without expending any charges.

While on the Prime Material Plane, the wielder gains a +4 bonus to saving throws against all air-based attacks and possesses total immunity to attacks from air elementals. Once per day, at the cost of 1 charge, the wielder may summon an 8-Hit Die air elemental as if casting the magic-user spell. Additionally, the staff can produce lightning bolt or cloudkill (cast as if by a 10th-level spellcaster) for 1 charge per use.

The staff may also be used to negate earth-based effects (earth being the opposing element of air). Negating an effect created by a Staff of Earth costs 1 charge, while negating a standard earth spell costs 2 charges—for example, a Staff of Air can dispel a spell-like wall of stone or entangling effect. A summoned earth elemental can likewise be banished back to its home plane at the same charge cost, though the wielder must touch the creature with the staff, requiring a standard attack roll if in combat.

When brought onto the Elemental Plane of Air, the staff grants entirely different abilities so long as at least 1 charge remains. The wielder gains complete immunity to the natural hazards and damage of the plane, vision out to a range of 60 feet, a movement rate of 120 feet per turn (40 feet per round), the ability to communicate with any resident of the plane, and a -4 bonus to Armor Class against attacks from its native inhabitants. Note that the staff does not grant the ability to breathe on the plane. However, if attuned alongside a matching Ring of Elemental Adaptation or Talisman of Elemental Travel, all of these planar benefits are extended to a 10-foot radius around the user.

Warning: If the Staff of Air is ever brought to its opposed realm—the Elemental Plane of Earth—it immediately detonates. The explosion fills a 60-foot radius sphere, inflicting 20 points of electrical damage plus 1d8 points of damage per remaining charge. All creatures within the blast may attempt a saving throw vs. spells with a -4 penalty for half damage; the wielder receives no saving throw.
system.unidentifiedDesc: This staff has a sturdy, polished appearance, made from a rich, dark wood. The top is adorned with a beautifully carved symbol of healing, surrounded by intricate designs that evoke a sense of divine power.
